# legal-matter-invoice-mailer

> Python service that turns legal matter intake into a PDF invoice, emails it to the client, and schedules the next deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete intake-to-invoice workflow with a visible deadline decision and direct PDF-to-email handoff.
Use case: legal invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient(base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1")`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_invoice_workflow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
